keyPoints: Badhte jansankhya ke liye anaaj utpadan badhana zaroori hai — isi liye krishi me vaigyanik sudhar kiye jaate hain taaki seemit zameen se zyada upaj mile.
Unnat beej, sahi samay par sinchai, santulit urvarak aur surakshit keetnashkon se fasal ki paidavar kayi guna badh jaati hai.
Kharif fasal (dhaan, makka, kapas) barish ke mausam me aur rabi fasal (gehu, chana, sarson) sardi ke mausam me boi jaati hai.
Mishrit kheti aur fasal chakra (crop rotation) se mitti ki urvarata bani rehti hai, keede kam lagte hain aur kisaano ko nuksan ka jokhim bat jaata hai.
Pashupalan me nasl sudhar, sahi chara-paani aur rog se bachav se doodh aur maans ka utpadan badhta hai; murgi palan ande deta hai.
Matsya palan aur madhumakkhi palan se kisaano ki aay badhti hai — ye kam lagat wale sahayak vyavsay hain jo gaon ki arthvyavastha majboot karte hain.
Aam galti: zyada urvarak aur keetnashak hamesha achha samajhna; adhik rasayan mitti ko banjar, paani ko zehreela aur bhojan ko hanikarak bana deta hai.
